Name: Seasonal Black Butler Sebastian
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
[size=4]UPDATE: may 15th 2025: [/size][size=3]My Dialogue Expansion for Black Butler Sebastian is out! You can find it here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33983 It includes the dialogue expansion as well as a new and improved character sprite/portrait pack, with new added expressions as well. I hope you love it ! <3[/size]

UPDATE: NEW for 1.2.0 May 1st 2025- added unique portraits for each festival.

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
-It replaces Sebastian's portraits + character sprites to become seasonal (different outfits for spring/summer/fall/winter so far. I am currently working on special holiday portraits which will be out soon) AND to look like the character Sebastian Michaelis from Black Butler. He is a demon butler who eats human souls! 

DONT CARE ABOUT IT BEING RELATED TO BLACK BUTLER?
-This mod is still great for you! If you like the art style it will just replace Sebastian's look for this anime-style cool guy instead with seasonal outfits. Plus he is taller + one pixel wider making him more aesthetically pleasing beside your farmer if that is what you like!

WANT EVEN MORE BLACK BUTLER IMMERSION?
-As you can see in one of the promo images, I am currently in testing for my Sebastian Michaelis Black Butler Dialogue Expansion mod. It is almost finished, I am just in the process of playing through more to ensure it is good to go before posting. It will be for pre + post marriage and will explain the lore of why the Demon Butler is in the Valley. There is also an additional 4 portraits for each season/event that accompanies the dialogue expansion to make for an even more immersive feel.

WHAT DO YOU NEED IN ORDER FOR THIS MOD TO WORK?
-SMAPI + Content Patcher

HOW TO INSTALL:
1. make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher downloaded already
2. download my zip file and unzip it into your Mods folder in Stardew Valley game files
3. start the game and the sprites/portraits should appear as they are supposed to!

CREDITS:
1. I was hugely inspired by Jellonip's Romanceable Rasmodius Redox Revamped. It is a wonderful mod for SVE that revamps the wizard character. If you have not, please go and check out RRRR-it is so well done, it adds so much lore and is great to play. It certainly has a professionally done feel and everything is very seamless with great immersion. (new areas, so many new lines, just a huge expansion overall), But particularly I was inspired by Jellonip for their character sprites. I used the shape of Magnus' body as a base to build Sebastian off of. I then made him taller and changed skin colours/hair/outfits + created all of Sebastian's character specific movements/emotes. 
2. A big THANK YOU to AirynS and their Seasonal Outfits Code Template. This template allowed me to create summer + fall specific portraits + sprites which I otherwise wouldn't have known how to make them run properly in the game.
3. On the same topic, if any mod creators, beginners too, need some guidance with making your created portraits and sprites run in the game, please check out PixelHag's guide for how to use AirynS's Seasonal Outfits Code Template. 


NOTE:
-I give permission for anybody to use these portraits and sprites and modify them for their own use. If you modify them and post, please give me credit. You are not allowed to reupload this
